resources.string: Used only to tap the Send button in WhatsApp for messages you scheduled in WA Scheduler. It only watches WhatsApp, WhatsApp Business and (if you turn on auto-unlock) the lock screen, and only acts while a scheduled message is being sent. Nothing is read, stored or sent anywhere else — the app has no internet permission.
Auto-send is off. Enable the WA Scheduler accessibility service so scheduled messages can be sent.
Allow \"Alarms & reminders\" so messages go out on time.
No scheduled messages yet.\nTap + to schedule one.
